# Hotel Mudaliyar (Mudaliyar Idly Kadai), Madurai

> South Indian restaurant in Madurai, Tamil Nadu. Late Thiru P. Kandasamy Mudaliyar started it in the 1960s as Mudaliyar Idly Kadai (முதலியார் இட்லி கடை), an evening stall beside the Goripalayam bus stand. It is famous for its muttai idli. Since 22 February 2026 it has been at Melamadai, Madurai.

## Key facts
- Name: Hotel Mudaliyar. Also known as Mudaliyar Idly Kadai, Mudaliyar Idli Kadai, ஹோட்டல் முதலியார்
- Phone: 0452 253 0303 (+91 452 253 0303), the same number as the Goripalayam kadai
- Address: No. 1-A, Pandi Kovil Ring Road, Melamadai, Near PC Perungudi, Madurai 625020, Tamil Nadu, India
- Former location: Goripalayam, Madurai 625002, next to the Goripalayam bus stand. The premises were acquired for the Goripalayam bridge construction.
- Founder: Late Thiru P. Kandasamy Mudaliyar (1960s). Now managed by Mr K. Tamilselvan.
- Hours: Breakfast 7:00–11:30 am, meals 12:00–3:30 pm, dinner 6:00–11:00 pm, all days
- Ordering: dine-in, takeaway at the counter, delivery on Swiggy and Zomato
- Function hall: Ammaiyappan Hall, air-conditioned, seats 120, on the first floor
- Cuisine: South Indian, Tamil, Madurai and Chettinad dishes, plus Indo-Chinese

## History
- At Goripalayam the kadai opened in the evening and stayed open till 3 am. Regulars came from the Government Hospital (GH), American College and the Madurai Court. Celebrities ate in or took food away.
- It appears in the Tamil film Kadhal (2004), starring Bharath and Sandhya, directed by Balaji Sakthivel, music by Joshua Sridhar.
- Press and TV coverage: a Tamil newspaper column on the muttai idli (then ₹20 a set), Kumudam, Vasantham TV Singapore, Kairali TV.

## Signature dishes
- Muttai Idli (idlis chopped and fried with egg and masala): ₹130
- Madurai Spl. Curry Dosa (chicken, mutton, prawn, boti, liver): ₹300–350
- Kothu Parotta (veg, egg, chicken, mutton): ₹130–350
- Seeraga Samba Chicken / Mutton Biryani: ₹270 / ₹300
